description: The values of Figure 1 (e, f, g) of Meng et al. 2022, read from the colours of its vector heatmaps. Each record is one heatmap rectangle: panel, token position (0 is the prompt's first token), layer or window centre, the rectangle's 8-bit fill colour, its colour-map bin and the value of that bin.

extraction.cells: every filled rectangle path 1.5 to 1.9 units wide and 7.5 to 9 units high; the panels are the runs of distinct x positions split at gaps over 5 units, in the order e, f, g; rows are a panel's distinct y positions from the top, columns its distinct x positions from the left

decode.rule: bin = the index of the colour-map entry (matplotlib, 256 entries) with the smallest summed absolute channel difference to rgb / 255, the lowest index on ties; value = floor + (bin + 0.5) / 256 * (top - floor), the bin's midpoint on the panel's colour bar. The floor and the tops are linear fits of each colour bar's tick labels to their positions, read at the ends of the bar and rounded.
